rows.question: On the Raspberry Pi 4B, how does the end-to-end latency of the radar-only model compare with the radar and vibration fusion model in the bathroom study?
rows.expected: Radar only 28.4 ms vs fusion 15.8 ms
rows.answer:
The radar and vibration fusion model on the same Raspberry Pi 4B gateway has an end-to-end latency of 15.8 ms (8.9 ms preprocessing, 6.7 ms inference). [1][4] The fusion model is therefore 28.4 ms − 15.8 ms = 12.6 ms faster end to end, about 15.8 / 28.4 ≈ 56% of the radar-only latency, even though its preprocessing is 1.4 ms slower (8.9 ms vs 7.5 ms). [1][5] The gain comes from inference, which drops from 19.8 ms for the radar-only model to 6.7 ms for the fusion model. [1][5]
